canonicalName: Rigid analytic spaces (Tate; analytic geometry over non-archimedean fields)

milestones.label: Tate's unpublished notes on rigid spaces
milestones.description: Tate introduces rigid spaces in 1962 as part of his work on uniformising p-adic elliptic curves with bad reduction; the notes are unpublished.

evidence.claim: Rigid spaces introduced by Tate in 1962

milestones.note: Unpublished notes; precursor only, does not set a derived date.

milestones.label: Tate: 'Rigid analytic spaces'
milestones.work: John Tate, Rigid analytic spaces, Invent. Math. 12 (1971) 257-289
milestones.description: Tate's first published definition of rigid analytic spaces via affinoid covers.

milestones.label: Name 'rigid analytic space' in a title
milestones.work: John Tate, Rigid analytic spaces, Invent. Math. 12 (1971)
milestones.description: The term 'rigid analytic space' appears in the title of the 1971 paper.
milestones.note: Same paper as the first_statement milestone; it plays both roles.

milestones.label: Raynaud: rigid spaces as generic fibres of formal schemes
milestones.work: Michel Raynaud, Geometrie analytique rigide d'apres Tate, Kiehl, ..., Bull. Soc. Math. France Mem. 39/40 (1974) 319-327
milestones.description: Raynaud (around 1970) interprets rigid spaces as generic fibres of formal schemes over a valuation ring, the key bridge to algebraic geometry.

evidence.claim: Raynaud 1974 Bull. SMF exposé cited in Wikipedia

milestones.note: Year 1974 is the publication of the exposé; the formal-model result is dated 'around 1970' in Wikipedia.

milestones.label: Bosch, Guntzer, Remmert: Non-Archimedean Analysis
milestones.work: Siegfried Bosch, Ulrich Guntzer, Reinhold Remmert, Non-Archimedean Analysis, Grundlehren 261, Springer (1984)
milestones.description: The standard systematic monograph on rigid and non-archimedean analysis.

milestones.label: Berkovich: spectral theory over non-archimedean fields
milestones.work: Vladimir Berkovich, Spectral Theory and Analytic Geometry over Non-Archimedean Fields, AMS Math. Surveys 33 (1990)
milestones.description: Reformulates rigid analytic geometry via spectra of Banach algebras, giving compact, connected non-archimedean spaces.

evidence.claim: AMS Surveys 33 record (2012 reprint in Crossref)
Berkovich reformulated the theory in the late 1980s

milestones.note: Original year 1990 is from the standard citation; Crossref shows the 2012 reprint.
